purpose: The plan for the Taal subject (design of 7/11/2026): the father's choices, what Flanders expects, the domains, sentence parsing (T1), word kinds (T2), verb spelling (T3) and later parts, colours, code structure, phases and deviations.
details: A long plan document with tables of the father's decisions (7/11 and 8/11), the official minimum goals Dutch (in force since 1 September 2025), the six domains with levels per school year, screens drawn in text, thinking steps and errors, the sentence machine, the colours of each sentence part, the phase table (T1.1... with ticks) and sections 'what turned out different than planned' per release (0.25.1, 0.26.0, 0.26.1, 0.26.2), open points and sources. The code that implements it is in kern/taal/*, terminal/zinsdelen.py, terminal/werkwoord.py and inhoud/taal/*.
summary: Taal plan. Records the father's choices (Steiner school, Catholic curriculum to stay ahead, abbreviations like 'o'), the Flemish minimum goals, six domains and the levels per year, details of T1 sentence parsing (steps, free colouring, thinking steps/tips, recognised errors, sentence machine and hand-written sentences, points), T2 word kinds, T3 verb spelling, colours per sentence part, how it fits the code, the phase table with ticks and per-release deviations from the plan.
